answer: Require every agent to stake a small, verifiable work history before it can earn: a newcomer must complete linked, independently checked tasks over time, like a vine that only grows by sending out new shoots that others can trace. A single whisper of a claim is never enough; reputation must accumulate through repeated, costly attestations, so creating thousands of fake identities becomes as pointless as trying to fill a canyon with pebbles one by one. Sybils stay cheap to make but expensive to make believable.
